result.title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
result.summary: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 automodel：把「模型发现」方法论编码成一个可移植的 agent skill，交由 Claude Code 等通用编码 agent 使用，并在天体物理、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流、轮胎动力学等案例中自动提出与改进模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选提出—评估反馈—迭代改进」的 agent 搜索与验证循环、以及把方法论固化为可移植 skill 的做法，可能为 LVR 的潜在假设生成、证据核验与停止决策的流程编排提供线索，可供核查其中是否含可迁移的验证与终止机制。
